settings.headline: Work that makes you
settings.subtitle: An international prize for illustration, poster and editorial design, photography and type. Six categories, one jury, and a gallery that grows as the entries come in.

settings.headline: Six categories, six deadlines
settings.subtitle: Pick the category that fits your work best. Not sure? Enter the one you would want to win.

settings.headline: The 2026 entries, so far
settings.subtitle: A selection of this year's work, shown with each entrant's permission.

settings.headline: From first entry to the ceremony
settings.subtitle: All deadlines are at 23:59 GMT on the day.

dates.label: 1 Sep 2026
dates.title: Entries open
dates.text: All six categories open for entries and nominations.

dates.label: 11 Dec 2026
dates.title: First deadline
dates.text: Illustration and Poster Design close at 23:59 GMT.

dates.label: 15 Jan 2027
dates.title: Main deadline
dates.text: Editorial, Photography and Type Design close. Students have until 5 February.

dates.label: 24 Apr 2027
dates.title: Ceremony in Lisbon
dates.text: Shortlist on 12 March, winners announced live in April.

settings.quote: The quietest picture in the room, and the one none of us could stop going back to.
settings.judge: Clara Okonjo, chair of the jury

settings.headline: Six judges see every entry
settings.subtitle: Each judge scores every entry on their own before the panel meets. Judges never score work they know.

judges.name: Clara Okonjo
judges.bio: Illustrator and teacher whose picture books are published in 14 languages.

judges.name: Henrik Vass
judges.bio: Runs a two-person studio known for festival posters and screen prints.

judges.name: Sofia Mendes
judges.bio: Has redesigned three national magazines and still prefers paper.

judges.name: Daniel Kim
judges.bio: Documentary photographer covering coastal towns and the people who stay.

judges.name: Lena Fischer
judges.bio: Designs text typefaces for newspapers and teaches type at a design academy.

judges.name: Ravi Sharma
judges.bio: Leads a public design team and mentors the student category winners.

settings.headline: Ready when
settings.text: Entering takes about ten minutes. You can change your entry until the deadline, and students enter for free.
